matchedPathReference: Fixed accepted share quantities/timing; previous close to current open gap PnL plus current open to close PnL at fixed FX. Equals final equity plus recorded fees/tax/slippage. Not an independent signal benchmark, cost-free rerun or same percentage exposure.
limitations: Retrospective diagnostics on already observed frozen prices; no parameter selection/optimization
2026 observations reserved and not used in this run; this is not out-of-sample significance evidence
Three correlated selected ETFs; calendar/corporate-action coverage not independently verified
Same original 2023Q1 quantity including original 10bp cost-buffer sizing, frozen across both costs and every quarter; target15% differs from actual integer-share exposure
Quarter reset rows are separate10000000KRW accounts, never summed or compounded into continuous performance
maxHold63 means63 observed daily closes in this study, not63 guaranteed trading days in live10s cadence. All candidates single-factor, no optimization or combined winner.

entryPolicy.deviation: 100*(current/current-inclusive MA20-1); original <=-5 Buy and >=+5 Sell inclusive thresholds retained
entryPolicy.level: Actual owned quantity gates flat Buy/owned Sell only; raw observations never manufacture ownership
entryPolicy.crossing: Previous deviation >-5 and current <=-5 creates candidate; retry while <=-5 until actual positive fill; >-5 cancels; strict history seeds no candidate
entryPolicy.trend200: Independent corrected-level entry filter, current price strictly > mean of previous200 observations, current excluded. Only entries blocked when unready. Replay uses strict prior history. Live clears separate trend context on first live observation, uses real live prior observations; generic daily/1m warmup never certified as10s cadence
entryPolicy.maxHold63: Independent corrected-level exit at observed held count>=63, counting first price observation after actual positive fill. Count also recorded when option off; same quantity, partial sell, warmup and reconfigure do not reset. Valid exact owner metadata restores count; positive restoration without an emitted entry candidate/age metadata is age unknown and triggers conservative exit candidate if maxHold enabled
entryPolicy.stop5: Independent corrected-level exit if current observed price <= native confirmed average fill price*(1-.05); signal at close, nextOpen fill. Includes neither fees nor FX PnL and is not an intrabar/5% loss cap
entryPolicy.exitPriority: Stop loss, then max holding, then original high deviation level. Protective exits request all currently owned shares; original level exit retains configured quantity and common clamp
entryPolicy.feedback: Equal zero/nextOpen pending is not fill; positive fill consumes entry candidate; partial positive remains owned and eligible. Rejected or pending sell never consumes ownership/age
entryPolicy.warmup: Legacy MA observation history retained; strict history seeds only observations, not fills/candidates/holding age; stop and max holding can protect owned positions without MA readiness
entryPolicy.reconfiguration: Same config preserves observation/candidate/ownership state. Changed params preserve native owned avg/quantity/age and live trend provenance, reseed only indicator/crossing state safely
entryPolicy.safety: Existing TradeGuard, risk limits and exact owner clamps remain. Stop reason includes 손절 and same-day reentry guard remains. No live or paper orders/autotrading/credentials accessed

compatibility.description: Non-Deviation entire backtest/signals exact against bca6601. Deviation raw, accepted, cash and accounting deltas measured without forced financial parity.
